method: For each split q, insert the primitive Parikh signature of every factor ending at q into an exact open-addressed hash table, then query the signature of every factor starting at q. Hash collisions are resolved by full packed-signature equality.
completeness: Every triple 0 <= p < q < r <= 38416 occurs uniquely at split q. The sweep either returns an exactly rechecked witness or, if completed, has queried every right factor against all left factors at that split.
test: all triples 0 <= p < q < r <= 38416 for h^4(0)
